title: QNLP in Practice: Running Compositional Models of Meaning on a Quantum Computer

facts.fact: A parse determines contraction and tensor arity; noun bending reduces cups while retaining the specified diagram. The demonstrated parser exploits a small vocabulary and grammar, not a qualified general Re-TACRED parse.

Representations have lexical parameters tied to vocabulary; source experiments learn word states from scratch. Source discusses pretraining as future work. Its output is a single-qubit binary classifier; not the original40-class contextual-feature contract.

Runs are conditioned on specific measured bits; success depends on parameters, so uniform2^(-p) is only an illustration, not a guaranteed lower bound. Longer postselected diagrams incur problematic sampling costs; this is not a universal impossibility of compositional quantum computation.

Reported comparisons are with quantum-friendly bag-of-words and sequence constructions simulated by tensor contractions. Simulated studies average20 runs; hardware studies use a single chosen initialization/run and8192 shots/circuit. Source does not certify independently trained strong unrestricted classical composition on this40-class task.
